verdict.rationale: Docs describe a real end-to-end path (assign an issue/task to Copilot's cloud coding agent, which plans, executes in a sandbox, opens a PR, and can be reviewed/merged from one workspace), matching the story closely. However, all supporting evidence is vendor documentation with no independent/community confirmation of this specific issue-to-PR workflow, and older community feedback raises concerns about autonomous 'fix the bug'/PR-generation quality ('braindead development', nebulous bug fixes), so real-world reliability is unverified.
